title: Meme Template Configuration

name.description: Human-readable name of the meme template

template_file.description: Plain file name of the template image in the templates directory (no sub-directories); .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .webp. The real format is sniffed from the file content.

description.description: Description of the meme and its typical usage

id.description: Unique identifier for this text area

position.description: Center of the text area in image pixels (must lie inside the image)

width.description: Maximum line width in pixels (text is wrapped to fit)

height.description: Maximum text block height in pixels

default_font_size.description: Font size (px) used when auto_resize is false

text_color.description: Named color (white, black, red, green, lime, blue, yellow, orange, purple, pink, cyan, magenta, gray, brown) or hex #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA

stroke_color.description: Named color (white, black, red, green, lime, blue, yellow, orange, purple, pink, cyan, magenta, gray, brown) or hex #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA

stroke_width.description: Outline radius in pixels (0 = no outline)

max_chars.description: Recommended maximum characters (exceeding it produces a warning, not an error)

usage.description: How this text area should be used

usage_rules.description: Rules and guidelines for using this meme template

additionalProperties.description: Caption text keyed by text area id

cultural_context.description: Origin of the meme and why it is funny

text_positioning_note.description: Guidance on where the text goes

description: Meme template config. The file name (without .json) is the template id and may only contain letters, digits, '_' and '-'. Semantic checks (colors, font ranges, area inside image) are enforced by the server at load time; failures appear in meme_generator_status load_errors.
